dataset_title: Okapi Wildlife Reserve monthly gross greenhouse-gas emissions data status

spatial_scope.name: Okapi Wildlife Reserve
spatial_scope.geometry_applied: Reserve polygon; no external buffer included

interpretation: The three requested reserve-wide gross-emission fields remain unknown, not zero. An assessment of the open CAMS GFAS 2026 fire-emissions product identified a potential experimental source for fire-only estimates, but its data could not be retrieved in this environment because CDS/ADS account authentication and manual acceptance of dataset terms are required. Even if retrieved, GFAS fire emissions alone would not represent total gross reserve emissions from all sources.

gross_emissions_co2e_all_gases__Mg.definition: Gross emissions from all included greenhouse gases, expressed as carbon-dioxide equivalent for the specified month and reserve polygon. Null means not quantifiable from evidence reviewed; it is not zero.

gross_emissions_co2e_non_co2__Mg.definition: Gross non-CO2 emissions (for example CH4 and N2O, if included by the documented inventory boundary) expressed as CO2e. Null means not quantifiable; no RFO-specific gas flux/activity data and factors were available.

gross_emissions_co2e_co2_only__Mg.definition: Gross CO2 emissions only for the specified month and reserve polygon. Null means not quantifiable; no validated emission event area, carbon-stock loss, or combustion estimate was available.

data_status.definition: The reporting month was assessed but no defensible gross-emissions amount can be calculated from the data reviewed.

satellite_observation_columns.definition: Contextual scene counts and Sentinel-2 vegetation indices for that month. These are not emission factors, event areas, or flux measurements.

satellite_data_inventory.limitation: NDVI/EVI do not identify or quantify emitted carbon; no validated change-to-emissions model was applied.
No Landsat raster metrics or disturbance areas processed.
No backscatter, disturbance areas, or biomass changes processed.

open_data_assessment.candidate_dataset: CAMS global biomass burning emissions based on fire radiative power (GFAS)
open_data_assessment.temporal_coverage: Hourly estimates and daily averages from 2026-01-01 to present; Jan-Oct 2026 falls within the advertised coverage.
open_data_assessment.method: Satellite fire-radiative-power assimilation converted to dry matter burned, then gas emissions using biome-specific emission factors. This is a model estimate for biomass-burning fires, not a direct ground measurement.
open_data_assessment.retrieval_limitations: The official CDS API instructions require a user account, personal access token, and manual acceptance of dataset terms before retrieval. No CDS API token was configured in this environment. No monthly reserve-intersected GFAS data were downloaded or calculated.
open_data_assessment.potential_calculation_if_retrieved: Integrate daily GFAS fluxes (kg m-2 s-1) by time and geodesic area of each 0.1-degree cell's intersection with the RFO polygon, converting kg to Mg. Report modeled fire-only CO2 mass separately; calculate non-CO2 CO2e from CH4 and N2O with a declared IPCC GWP assessment and time horizon; define fire-only all-gases as CO2-only plus those included non-CO2 components. Preserve grid-cell coverage and model uncertainty.
open_data_assessment.scope_caveat: GFAS covers fire-related emissions only. It cannot alone quantify the requested all-source gross emissions from non-fire deforestation/degradation, logging, mining, agriculture, fuel use, ecosystem fluxes, or other sources. GFAS's 0.1-degree grid is also coarse relative to reserve boundaries.

other_open_data_reviewed.source: NASA FIRMS VIIRS/MODIS active fire products
other_open_data_reviewed.review_result: The Area API requires a free FIRMS MAP_KEY. No key was configured, so no RFO Jan-Oct 2026 detections were retrieved. Active-fire detections indicate thermal anomalies, not burned area or emitted mass.
The catalog reports coverage ending 2020-12; it cannot provide observed 2026 burned area.
The annual loss-year band covers 2001-2025; it cannot provide 2026 forest-loss observations.
The repository's earlier API check found that a valid API key is required; no boundary-level monthly alert counts were obtained. Alerts are not direct carbon-flux estimates.

calculation_method.current: No reserve-wide gross-emissions values or GFAS fire-only values were calculated. Requested reserve-wide fields remain null rather than inserting zero or treating an inaccessible model product as retrieved data.
calculation_method.experimental_fire_only_candidate: If GFAS 1.4.2 is retrieved, it can support an explicitly labeled, coarse-resolution modeled fire-only estimate, not the complete reserve gross-emissions fields. The requested total fields must remain null unless a full-source accounting boundary is supported.
required_for_quantification: Retrieve and archive the requested CAMS GFAS dates through authenticated CDS/ADS access after accepting the dataset terms; retain product version and coverage metadata.
Validate monthly disturbed/burned/conversion area against optical and radar time series and reference data.
Determine affected land-use/pool transitions and pre-disturbance carbon stocks with appropriate biomass/soil datasets and field or validated model support.
Apply DRC- and ecosystem-appropriate emission factors with explicit carbon pools, combustion/decay, and uncertainty.
Quantify CH4 and N2O where applicable using activity data and appropriate factors; convert gases to CO2e using an explicitly cited IPCC assessment basis and time horizon.
Document gross accounting boundary; prevent double-counting between CO2-only and non-CO2 components; reconcile all-gases total.

citation: NASA CMR, Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC, CAMS GFAS, NASA FIRMS, ESA CCI FireCCI, Hansen/UMD Global Forest Change, and Global Forest Watch catalog/API documentation; see source-specific retrieval status and limitations. Catalog coverage and model availability are not evidence of retrieved RFO values.

spatial_satellite_layer.interpretation: Relative October NDVI screening zones only. These are not validated ecological, degradation, biomass, or emissions classes.
